# Blink X

> Blink X (TheBlinkX) plans, shoots and edits Instagram Reels and short-form video for businesses and brands across India, delivered within 24 hours after the shoot.

## Docs

- [Blink X Homepage](https://www.theblinkx.com/): Overview of Blink X's content-day service — planning, shooting, editing, pricing packages, FAQs and booking, for businesses and brands in India.
- [Reels Production Services](https://www.theblinkx.com/reels-production): Dedicated page on Blink X's Reels production service, covering the process, who it's for, package pricing and booking FAQs.

## Key Facts

- Service: Instagram Reels / short-form video production for businesses, brands, creators and personal brands.
- Area served: India.
- Delivery: Ready-to-post Reels within 24 hours after the shoot.
- Packages: Starter (8 Reels, ₹10,000, ₹5,000 advance), Growth (12 Reels, ₹15,000, ₹7,500 advance, most popular), Scale (18 Reels, ₹25,000, ₹12,500 advance).
- Payment: 50% advance reserves the content day; remaining 50% due on delivery.
- What's included: Content planning and scripting, professional on-location shooting, editing, captions/subtitles, music and sound design, colour grading.
